rules.description: Read approval/recall evidence without performing an approval or financial transition.

provenance.note: The product documentation establishes operational context, not the sample export schema or revision algorithm.

rules.description: Review approved/unbilled transaction details before customer invoicing, stopping before confirmation or actuals creation.

provenance.note: Only a local review packet is produced; no product or financial action is executed.

rules.description: Reject malformed schemas/duplicate primary IDs; quarantine identity or highest-revision ambiguity before checking period, chargeability, prior billing, approval and price/policy.

provenance.note: Exact types, half-open periods, cutoff inclusivity, conflict precedence and no arbitrary tie-break are fictional explicit rules.

rules.description: Require a unique effective project-role-currency rate and round minutes times hourly rate divided by 60 half-up per entry before summing.

provenance.note: No inferred rate, aggregate rounding, overtime, tax, or FX.

rules.description: Check explicit category/currency policy, whole-expense cap and receipt at or above the threshold; do not truncate or convert.

provenance.note: All monetary caps and thresholds are supplied fictional policy, not reimbursement or regulatory rules.

rules.description: Produce exact add/update/remove diagnostics; ambiguous drafts, duplicate details, unknown joins or contradictions require clarification, not speculative removal.

provenance.note: Zero tolerance. Null unknown amounts never enter a complete-total variance. Cap-held corrections are diagnostic-only.

rules.description: Count raw as-of billed transactions in the service period even without current source entries; if known prior plus candidates exceeds the cap, hold the whole project's candidates. Equality is allowed.

provenance.note: No partial allocation, credits, implicit deduplication, or foreign-currency conversion. Incomplete calculations remain explicitly incomplete.

rules.description: Account for every entry, draft line, draft, prior transaction and project with owned review exceptions and currency-separated known subtotals.

provenance.note: Stable output ordering and trace evidence describe a synthetic local run only; no financial execution or native success is implied.

steps.title: Inventory the frozen billing exports
steps.procedure: Read only the supplied attachment. Inventory all nine logical arrays and the explicit service period, zero tolerance and as-of cutoff.

steps.title: Validate every record before calculating
steps.procedure: Enforce exact keys, nonnegative two-decimal money, positive integer minutes/revisions, offset-aware whole-second instants, dates, enums and unique primary IDs. Reject malformed bundles with empty outputs and offending field messages.

steps.title: Cross-reference independent exports
steps.procedure: Join entry type plus ID to approvals, prior transactions and draft details; join project, effective project-role-currency rate and category-currency expense policy. Keep source-absent historical billing. Expose missing and contradictory identity links.

steps.title: Resolve as-of approval and exclusions
steps.procedure: Ignore future approval/billing evidence. Select the unique highest eligible approval revision, never a timestamp or row-order winner at a conflicting revision. Quarantine identities/approval ambiguity first; otherwise exclude out-of-period, nonchargeable, already-billed and nonapproved entries in that order.

steps.title: Price time and check expense evidence
steps.procedure: For approved entries, price each time entry independently at its unique effective rate. Check expenses against their explicit currency policy, inclusive receipt threshold and whole-amount cap. Preserve unknown charges as null.

steps.title: Reconcile each draft detail
steps.procedure: Compare uniquely assigned known amounts exactly. Emit matches, missing candidate additions, updates or definite ineligibility removals. Duplicate/unknown/contradictory evidence gets clarify-not-remove; out-of-period drafts are deferred. Never compare a partial expected subtotal to a complete draft total.

steps.title: Compute period consumption and whole-project holds
steps.procedure: Sum raw countable prior transactions and rounded candidate charges per project. Show known consumption and full proposed consumption only when complete. A known amount above cap holds all known candidates; equality is allowed. Mark affected detail corrections diagnostic-only.

steps.title: Assign correction and clarification review
steps.procedure: Assign each hold, clarification or proposed correction to the synthetic project owner, data steward, or input provider. Keep reason messages and input identities; no transaction is modified.

steps.title: Close the local review packet
steps.procedure: Emit the common envelope with complete ordered entry, prior-billing, detail, draft, project and currency summaries plus closure counts and owned exceptions. State review-only boundaries and preserve all uncomputed amounts.
